title: End-to-end playable game loop scene
description: A playable scene wiring bootstrap -> 4-player input -> sequencer -> microgames -> command/intermission -> HUD -> end-of-round results. This is the milestone-1 vertical slice.
acceptance_criteria: Launching the scene runs a full round of several microgames for 4 players with live scoring.
The flow shows command verb, gameplay, and intermission between microgames, with the corner HUD updating.
An end-of-round results screen shows final standings.
From launch, a new player can be playing within ~60 seconds with zero instructions (zero-setup goal).
